chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban narrated to us from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Isma'il al-Ju'fi, that he heard Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

I have been given five things that were not given to anyone before me: the Earth has been made a pure place of prostration for me, spoils of war have been permitted to me, I have been supported by awe, I have been given comprehensive language, and I have been granted intercession.

key_terms.الشفاعة: al-shafa'a - intercession on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.المغنم: al-maghnam - spoils/booty of war, made lawful for the Prophet's nation
key_terms.جوامع الكلم: jawami' al-kalim - comprehensive speech: the ability to express vast meanings in few words

ai.seo_question: What five things were given uniquely to Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW), as narrated by Imam al-Baqir (AS), lists five unique distinctions given to him by Allah. These are foundational to Islamic law and theology: the universality of prayer locations, the permissibility of war spoils, divine support through fear cast into enemies' hearts, the gift of concise yet comprehensive speech, and the power of intercession on the Day of Judgment.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (rh) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Aban narrated to us from al-Husayn b. Sa`id from Ibn Abi `Umayr from Hammad b. `Uthman from Isma`il al-Ju`fi.

He heard Aba Ja`far al-Baqir (as) say: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: I have been given five things that were not given to anyone before me: (1) The Earth has been made a pure place of prostration (masjid) for me, (2) spoils have been permitted to me, (3) I have been supported by fear, (4) I have been given comprehensive language (jawami` al-kalim), and (5) I have been granted the ability to intercede.
